title: SecB Knowledge Artifact (WP1 deliverable 4)
description: Formalizes SECB-FAIL-LEARN-001 section 9 (KCS v6-inspired knowledge lifecycle, K0/K1) as strict JSON Schema. Matrix row 3: positive proof 'Reviewed lineage advances to K1'; negative proof 'Missing reviewer, scope, or evidence rejects'. LIMITATIONS deferred to semantic-validator.mjs: (1) whether any reviewer_id in `reviewers` is actually distinct from author_actor_id or from the source Experience Record's source_actor_id/checker_id -- JSON Schema without $data cannot compare a nested array element's field against a sibling top-level field's value. validateIndependentKnowledgeReview performs that cross-field/cross-document comparison (SCEN-08); as of rework round 02 (SEC-FL-WP1-N001) a K1 claim with no source Experience Record supplied to the check fails CLOSED rather than silently skipping the author/experience-actor cross-check, so the caller can no longer bypass independence verification merely by omitting the optional experienceDoc argument. (2) whether scope.tenant_id genuinely matches the cited Experience Record's scope -- validateTenantLineageConsistency, genuinely wired for Knowledge as of rework round 02 (REV-001; the original WP1 cut wired this only for Experience Records despite this same description claiming otherwise -- see 02-rework-001-defect-correction.yaml). validateNoDerivationFromDeprecatedKnowledge (SCEN-14) is likewise semantic-only: it is exercised from the Skill Candidate side (a skill candidate's knowledge_maturity_at_binding claim is cross-checked against this document's actual maturity_state).

redaction_attestation.description: Added rework round 02 (SEC-FL-WP1-002). Knowledge Artifact's applicability/diagnosis/verified_cause/resolution/prevention are the exact free-text fields (up to 4096 chars each) SEC's review named as carrying zero secret-pattern guard. Self-declared attestation only -- see common.schema.json#/$defs/redaction_attestation for the full limitation note; not verified by semantic-validator.mjs.

allOf.description: SCEN-08 / matrix row 3: a lesson cannot become knowledge without independent review -- K1 requires at least one reviewer verdict, and that verdict must be APPROVED (schema-provable: 'contains'). Which reviewer id counts as independent of the author is a semantic-validator concern (see description above).
DEPRECATED/SUPERSEDED knowledge must name what superseded it (section 9: 'Interpretation may be revised; sealed evidence may not' -- supersession is append-only, not overwrite).
